guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows recommendationservice CPU usage spiking by 562% (z=+52.54) and socket connections increasing by 535% (z=+106.99), which directly correlates with a >5000% surge in its p90 latency. This resource exhaustion in recommendationservice is causing request timeouts that propagate to frontendservice, triggering the external error alert and high-latency traces.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the CPU resource limits for recommendationservice and optimize its request handling loop to reduce socket churn, which will alleviate the latency bottleneck.
